mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='idle' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS idle, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='rented' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS rented, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='repair' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS repair, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='scrapped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS scrapped FROM bike_vehicle

SELECT s.id AS station_id,s.name AS station_name,s.status AS station_status,COUNT(v.id) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v.status='idle' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS idle, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v.status='rented' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS rented, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v.status='repair' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS repair, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v.status='scrapped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS scrapped FROM bike_station s LEFT JOIN bike_vehicle v ON v.station_id=s.id GROUP BY s.id,s.name,s.status ORDER BY s.name,s.id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS bill_count,COALESCE(SUM(payable_amount),0) AS receivable, COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount),0) AS received,COALESCE(SUM(payable_amount-paid_amount),0) AS outstanding FROM bike_bill created_at >= #{fromTime}AND created_at < #{toTime}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM bike_payment_record paid_at >= #{fromTime}AND paid_at < #{toTime}
